effect_text:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow Digimon card and 1 purple Digimon card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with the [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait, reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 2.
inherited_text: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
